goal: Stop invalidateblock from reporting success when block disconnection fails
Avoid leaving callers unaware that a chain was only partially rolled back
Explicitly reject attempts to invalidate the genesis block
agreement: Substantive support for reporting partial rollback failures rather than silent success (yusufyildiz34)
Suggests documenting partial rollback as a known limitation instead of adding code (l0rinc)
Asks whether preserving the earlier validation error on flush failure is intentional (cyb3ralbert)
Requested a more thorough pull request description (pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because reporting success on a partial rollback misleads automated callers.
The command is primarily an administrative and testing tool, which limits user impact.

categories.name: validation
why: P4 because it only records failure details in validation state without altering core logic.
The validation improvements are marginal and exist mainly to feed the caller error message.
